name: GD3 Official Plugin Store
description: Official plugin repository for GamesDownloader V3

plugins.name: NEON HORIZON Theme
plugins.description: Cyberpunk theme with Steam Big Picture library views, Colorful Pop couch mode with game carousel, 8 color skins, and full gamepad support.
plugins.author: 60plus
plugins.changelog:
v1.4.2: requires GamesDownloader 1.0.32, without which the clear-metadata panel showed a raw translation key.

v1.4.1: Clearing every scraped field for a library now asks you to tick a box before the button will work. Deleting a ROM is already asked the same way by GamesDownloader itself.

plugins.name: TheGamesDB
plugins.description: Cover art, fanart, logos and metadata from TheGamesDB.net - the open video game database. Provides boxart covers, fanart backgrounds, clearlogo images and game metadata.
plugins.author: 60plus
plugins.changelog:
v1.0.3: developers are named instead of showing TheGamesDB's internal id numbers.

v1.0.2: no longer reports the age rating as a score, which showed on a game's page as NaN out of ten.

v1.0.1: the plugin can be installed again - the manifest asked for a GamesDownloader version that does not exist. The API key is now a password field, so it is hidden from ordinary users and stored encrypted from 1.0.32 onwards.

v1.0.0: Initial release - covers, fanart, clearlogo, metadata search

plugins.name: Steam Deck Compatibility
plugins.description: Shows ProtonDB Steam Deck compatibility (platinum/gold/silver/bronze/borked) as a colored Steam Deck badge on Games Library covers and, on the game detail page, the ProtonDB tier plus Valve's official Deck Verified status (Verified/Playable/Unsupported) with an expandable list of the verified criteria. The ProtonDB tier and Deck status can also be set by hand (with editable criteria notes) for games missing from ProtonDB. Works across all layouts and future themes; titles are matched to Steam and cached on the server. Available in 8 languages.
plugins.author: 60plus
plugins.changelog:
v1.0.5: Rating aggregation compatibility - the plugin declares its entries as badge-style (tiers/statuses, not numeric scores) via the metadata_provider_ratings hook, so ProtonDB tiers and Deck Verified statuses stay badges and never feed the new aggregate rating. Requires GamesDownloader v1.0.15+.
v1.0.4: Split into two separate rows - ProtonDB tier and the Valve Deck Verified status - rendered natively by the active theme via the GamesDownloader v1.0.10 registerDetailRow API; matches every layout (Modern, Classic and future themes). Falls back to the single combined row on older cores.
v1.0.3: Deck Verified status (Valve certification) with expandable criteria; manual override of the ProtonDB tier and Deck status with editable criteria notes; i18n (8 languages). Requires GamesDownloader v1.0.4+ for saving manual edits.
v1.0.2: Store icon fix (served via the icon proxy) and store screenshots.
v1.0.1: ProtonDB (SteamDB/Algolia) search, manual search + Steam appid fallback, Steam Deck tab in the metadata editor, theme-agnostic cover badges.

plugins.name: Vapor Theme
plugins.description: Storefront theme in the spirit of big game launchers: hero carousel with trailers, category shelves, rich hover cards and animated tiles. Includes its own Steam-style game and GOG detail pages, a complete Retro experience (console picker, per-platform libraries, ROM detail pages with in-browser play) and full global search. 7 color skins, translated to 8 languages, arranged on the page itself
plugins.author: 60plus
plugins.changelog:
v1.0.14: a ROM's checksums are listed among its facts, and the button that computes them confirms when it has.

v1.0.13: a rating that is not a number is no longer shown at all instead of rendering as NaN.

v1.0.12: removing a library game asks for a tick first, the number of files that go with a disc is stated on the question that decides them, and a file with no checksums gets a button that computes them. Requires GamesDownloader 1.0.32.

v1.0.11: Deleting a ROM or a GOG game now asks you to tick a box before the button will work. The saves, the artwork and the library entry go on that first answer, whichever way you answer the question about files afterwards, so that is where the question belongs. Clearing a whole library's metadata asks the same way.

plugins.name: PC Ports
plugins.description: Catalogue of open-source console ports, recompilations and emulators published as GitHub releases, offered as a storefront your server can download from. The list is maintained by SirDiabo (GHLAppList) and modelled on the GithubLauncher desktop app (https://github.com/SirDiabo/GithubLauncher); GamesDownloader hosts nothing and is not responsible for the listed software or its availability, it only bridges that list into a server storefront.
plugins.author: 60plus
plugins.changelog:
v1.0.1: reads its settings through the core helper, so the GitHub token keeps working on GamesDownloader 1.0.32, which stores plugin credentials encrypted.

v1.0.0: Initial release - a storefront for open-source console ports, recompilations and emulators published as GitHub releases, with metadata scraping and per-OS builds. The list is maintained by SirDiabo (GHLAppList) and modelled on the GithubLauncher desktop app. Requires GamesDownloader 1.0.27.
